# Vendored 2025 Dependencies

The 2025 archive vendors Bootstrap 5.3.3 so its layout and interactions do not depend on a mutable third-party CDN.

The files were retrieved from the Bootstrap 5.3.3 package on jsDelivr.

- `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css` has SHA-256 `3c8f27e6009ccfd710a905e6dcf12d0ee3c6f2ac7da05b0572d3e0d12e736fc8`.
- `bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` has SHA-256 `0833b2e9c3a26c258476c46266e6877fc75218625162e0460be9a3a098a61c6c`.
